title: swissknifeman project config (.swissknife.json)
description: Easy project config: selecting buckets/exceptions/profile for channels connect (bucket-granular) and legacy vendor. Vendor-mode `skiller sync` uses a separate, extended .swissknifeman/config.json (see swissknifeman-config.schema.json). Keys are kept in sync with CONFIG_KEYS (lib/skiller/common.py) — gate tests/test_schema.py and skiller doctor.

project_type.description: Project Type Profile (profiles/<id>.json): laravel-project, php-package, obsidian-vault, standalone etc. Validated against an actual set of profiles.

plugins.description: Accurate project-local set marketplace-plugins for connect; null/missing - select by buckets/profile/autodetect.

exclude.description: Eliminate skills. Skill-granular in vendor; in connect (plugins) is ignored.

agent.description: Target agent. Default skills_path: claude→.claude/skills, cursor→.cursor/skills, generic→.ai/skills.

providers.description: Optional provider-config v1.0.0; runtime resolution executes shared core resolver.

memory_brain.description: Brain-valt (optional). String = path (backward compatibility: fed memory-hook). Object = doc-sync: path + synchronization rules BRAIN↔project.

sync.description: Rules doc-sync between BRAIN and the project.

patterns.description: glob-file patterns for synchronization (relative to root BRAIN/project).

skills_map.description: Reserved: domain→skills for preloading roles under the stack (not yet implemented).

policy_profile.description: Expected policy-settings profile Claude Code: the host settings doctor (`skiller doctor --settings`) checks the effective configuration of layers against the profile configs/claude-code/policy/<name>.json (e.g. max-permissive, base). Drift = find. The home of the declaration is here, not in.claude/settings.json.
